name: slack-thread-to-issue
description: Scans your chat channels (the ones you name, else your 8 most active; last 3 days by default, 1 to 14 if you ask) for threads that reached a conclusion with an action nobody has tracked yet: 'I'll fix it', 'let's add a retry', 'agreed, can someone file this'. For each one it proposes an issue for your issue tracker (an imperative title, a description with the verbatim decision quote, the participants and the thread link, the team) and checks the tracker for an issue that already tracks it. Threads with no outcome, threads whose action is already done and threads that already carry an issue link are left alone. It creates each issue only after you approve that exact issue, one card per issue, then offers a fixed 'Tracked as KEY: link' reply in the thread and posts it only after you approve that too. It never sets an assignee or priority. On demand only: it cannot watch channels continuously. Paste a thread if your chat is not connected.

skills.name: Chat threads to issues
skills.description: Concluded chat threads with an untracked action (3 days by default, 1-14): one proposed tracker issue per thread with the verbatim decision quote and the thread link, duplicates flagged as already tracked, each issue created only after you approve it, then a 'Tracked as KEY: link' thread reply posted only after you approve it.
